title: Understanding MSE and MAE
text: Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) are both used to measure the accuracy of a model. MSE squares the differences between predicted and actual values, while MAE takes the absolute value of these differences. Think about how squaring affects the error values compared to taking the absolute value.
